context.transcript:
Mr. Garcia, I see from your resume that you're interested in a law internship here at Sohota and Partners.
Yes, I'd like to learn all that I can about working in legal services.
Plus, I'm looking forward to putting the knowledge I've gained at university to practical use.
Well, if you're selected, you'll work alongside a mentor on several large cases.
Most interns find the work challenging but very rewarding.
That sounds great.
I've always admired the work of Sohota and Partners.
In fact, I'd really like to get a full-time position here someday.
Are interns often hired after completing their internships?
context.transcript_translation:
Garcia 先生，我看到您的简历显示您对在 Sohota and Partners 实习法律服务很感兴趣。
是的，我想了解所有关于从事法律服务工作的一切知识。
此外，我也期待将我在大学学到的知识投入实际应用。
嗯，如果您被选中，您将在一位导师的指导下参与几个大型案件。
大多数实习生觉得这份工作很有挑战性但非常有意义。
听起来很棒。
我一直钦佩 Sohota and Partners 的工作。
事实上，我将来真的很希望能在贵公司获得一份全职职位。
实习生在完成实习后经常被聘用吗？
